**Job Title:** IBM MQ / Middleware Administrator

**Location:** Based on project requirements (on-site)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 4-6 years  
**Salary:** ₹7 - ₹8.4 per annum

About Us

We are an aviation IT solutions company delivering airport systems integration, enterprise middleware, operational technology platforms, and digital transformation services to airports and aviation stakeholders. Our projects run in high-availability environments where secure, scalable, and reliable integrations across multiple airport systems are essential.

Role Summary

We are hiring an experienced MQ Administrator to own our enterprise messaging and middleware infrastructure in a 24x7 operational setting. You will handle installation, configuration, monitoring, security, troubleshooting, and performance tuning of IBM MQ and related middleware, working closely with application, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and operations teams.

Key Responsibilities

**MQ & Middleware Administration**

* Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain IBM MQ across development, test, staging, and production environments.
* Set up and manage queue managers, queues, channels, listeners, clusters, topics, and security settings.
* Support distributed MQ deployments on Linux, Windows, and cloud platforms.
* Implement and maintain clustering, multi-instance queue managers, failover, and high-availability designs.
* Run regular health checks and preventive maintenance.
* Track queue depth, channel status, message flow, and overall middleware performance.
* Diagnose messaging failures, connectivity problems, latency, and integration incidents.
* Manage SSL/TLS configuration and certificates to keep messaging secure.
* Put backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures in place.
* Maintain middleware standards, naming conventions, and operating procedures.

**Integration Support**

* Work with application teams, system integrators, OEM vendors, and infrastructure teams during deployments and integrations.
* Support integrations between mission-critical airport operational systems.
* Help troubleshoot interfaces across enterprise systems, operational databases, APIs, and third-party applications.
* Review message flow logs and transaction traces to resolve issues.
* Support SIT, UAT, production rollouts, and cutovers.

**Monitoring & Incident Management**

* Provide L2/L3 support for production middleware incidents.
* Take part in 24x7 support and on-call rotations as needed.
* Conduct root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* Meet SLA, availability, and operational KPI targets.
* Keep incident records, operational logs, and technical documentation up to date.

**Security & Compliance**

* Align middleware infrastructure with organizational cybersecurity policies.
* Apply authentication, authorization, encryption, and audit logging controls.
* Support vulnerability remediation, security audits, and compliance work.
* Partner with cybersecurity teams on hardening and risk reduction.

**Automation & Improvement**

* Build and maintain scripts for monitoring, deployment, backup, and maintenance.
* Identify opportunities for performance tuning and process improvement.
* Contribute to infrastructure modernization and cloud migration initiatives where relevant.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on IBM MQ administration experience.
* Proven experience administering enterprise middleware in production.
* Working knowledge of Linux and Windows server environments.
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP, networking, firewalls, and secure communication protocols.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery setups.
* Shell or other automation scripting skills.
* Familiarity with ITIL incident and change management.

Preferred Skills

* Background in aviation, airport systems, transportation, or other mission-critical domains.
* Exposure to IBM ACE/IIB, Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, or similar platforms.
* Experience with containerized or cloud-based middleware.
* Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, AppDynamics, or Splunk.
* Understanding of REST/SOAP APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience on large-scale system integration projects.
* Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD practices.

Behavioral Competencies

* Ownership and accountability.
* Composure under pressure in 24x7 environments.
* Clear communication and coordination.
* Attention to detail and operational discipline.
* Proactive approach to problem-solving.
* Ability to work with cross-functional, multicultural teams.
* Strong documentation and reporting habits.
* Willingness to learn new technologies.

Working Conditions

* Shift work and on-call rotations may be required.
* Support may be needed during production cutovers, migrations, and critical operational events.

What We Offer

* Work on large-scale international aviation and airport technology projects.
* Hands-on exposure to mission-critical enterprise systems.
* A collaborative, technology-focused team.
* Career growth in enterprise integration and middleware.
* Competitive pay and professional development support.

How to Apply

Send your updated resume with relevant project experience, certifications, and current notice period.

**Work Location:** In person

Pay: ₹65,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

description:
**Location : Ludhiana**

**Some careers open more doors than others**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor:**

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

**Job Introduction**

The Universal Banker (UB) role within HSBC's International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) is pivotal in executing a multiyear growth strategy. This strategy is centered on positioning HSBC as a global bank committed to India's long-term growth story, leveraging its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for expansion, with plans to add 14 more branches to its existing fleet of 32 branches. The Universal Banker will play a crucial customer-facing role, servicing primarily walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. This role is integral to delivering effective branch customer interface functions in the front office and teller areas, aligning with the TCF principles to transition from mere transaction processing to need-based sales.

**Principal Responsibilities**

  

* Ensure effective delivery of branch customer interface functions to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
* Implement TCF principles in daily customer interactions, transitioning from transaction processing to need-based sales.
* Maintain branch hygiene standards by ensuring promotional materials are correctly displayed and the banking hall and ATMs are clean.
* Manage customer complaints and escalations to ensure a positive customer experience.
* Migrate customers to alternate delivery channels in a friendly manner.
* Adhere to operational standards set by the bank, maintaining control over customer deliverables and implementing audit recommendations.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and cross selling credit card, personal loan and general & wealth insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

  

* Graduate degree
* Experience ranging from 2-3 years

**Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes within the bank.
* Sound understanding of the company's customer service requirements.
* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Ability to establish mutual respect and trust in dealing with others, working effectively as part of a team.
* Demonstrated business focus and customer orientation, providing exemplary service.
* Awareness of AML risk and adherence to regulatory guidelines and internal AML & Sanction Policy.
* Ability to manage and fulfill customer requirements to their satisfaction, ensuring a positive customer experience consistently.

**Skills**

* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* **Strong Interpersonal Skills:** Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* **Highly Organized:** Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* **Proactive and Efficient:** Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications:**

* FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

**Pro-tip :** Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

description:
The F&B Host/Hostess is responsible for welcoming and greeting guests, managing reservations, coordinating seating arrangements, and ensuring a warm and professional first impression. The role focuses on guest satisfaction, smooth restaurant operations, and maintaining the hotel's hospitality standards.

Key Responsibilities

* Welcome and greet guests warmly and professionally upon arrival.
* Manage restaurant reservations, walk-in guests, and seating arrangements.
* Escort guests to their tables and present menus when required.
* Maintain the waiting list and communicate estimated waiting times.
* Answer telephone calls, handle inquiries, and confirm reservations.
* Coordinate with restaurant service staff to ensure smooth seating and service.
* Monitor table availability and manage guest flow during busy periods.
* Handle guest requests, feedback, and complaints courteously.
* Maintain the cleanliness and presentation of the entrance, reception, and waiting areas.
* Communicate special occasions, VIP arrivals, and guest preferences to the service team.
* Maintain accurate reservation records and guest information according to hotel policies.
* Follow hotel grooming standards, etiquette, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Assist in coordinating special events, group bookings, and restaurant functions.
* Ensure guests receive a positive and memorable dining experience.

Qualifications and Skills

* Minimum 10+2 qualification; a diploma or degree in Hotel Management is preferred.
* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Pleasant personality and professional grooming.
* Strong customer service and guest-handling skills.
* Good telephone etiquette and reservation management skills.
* Ability to multitask and remain calm during busy periods.
* Teamwork, patience, and problem-solving abilities.
* Knowledge of hotel reservation systems is an advantage.
* Previous experience in hotel or restaurant operations is preferred.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Premier Service Manager- Jalandhar
description:
**Location: Jalandhar**

**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor:**

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

**Job Introduction**

The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer-facing, primarily servicing walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.

**Principal Responsibilities**

  

* Provide high-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

  

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* **Strong Interpersonal Skills:** Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* **Highly Organized:** Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* **Proactive and Efficient:** Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications:**

FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.

**Additional Notes :**

Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

description:

The Senior Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online Engineer provides day-to-day platform engineering and operational ownership across the Microsoft 365 tenants supporting the Enterprise 1099 population. The role supports reliable tenant services, governed change, migration delivery, and alignment with enterprise configuration standards.

This role supports a dedicated engineering function responsible for governing and securing the Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environments for USHealth Group, HealthMarkets, and First Family Insurance. The environment supports roughly 10,000 external 1099 agents. The position will help align tenant operations, identity controls, email protections, telemetry, and change governance with enterprise policies while supporting the HealthMarkets Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migration.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Engineer and administer Microsoft 365 tenant services with primary ownership for Exchange Online and messaging operations
* Manage mailboxes, recipients, groups, shared resources, accepted domains, transport configuration, and administrative settings
* Plan and execute mailbox onboarding, migration waves, coexistence activities, cutover tasks, and post-migration support
* Support tenant configuration, license assignment processes, service health monitoring, capacity planning, and operational reporting
* Develop and maintain PowerShell automation for repeatable administration, validation, reporting, and bulk operations
* Troubleshoot service incidents, mail delivery issues, client connectivity, permissions, and configuration defects
* Execute changes through approved ServiceNow and enterprise change-management processes
* Coordinate with identity and email security engineers to deliver integrated, secure tenant services
* Support HealthMarkets discovery, Microsoft 365 tenant build, migration, DNS cutover, hypercare, and steady-state transition
* Maintain technical standards, diagrams, inventories, support runbooks, knowledge articles, and audit evidence
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online in a large or complex environment
* Experience executing migrations and supporting production cutovers and hypercare
* Demonstrated experience with recipient management, transport configuration, migration, mail flow, and service troubleshooting
* Working knowledge of identity dependencies, security controls, DNS, SMTP, and enterprise monitoring
* Proficiency with Exchange Online PowerShell and Microsoft 365 administrative tools
* Proven ability to follow formal incidents, change, problem, and service-management processes
* Demonstrated solid written communication and technical documentation skills

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert or current equivalent
* Relevant Exchange Online, messaging, or Microsoft 365 certification
* Experience supporting separate, external-facing, or multi-tenant Microsoft 365 environments
* Experience with Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migration tooling and methodologies
* Experience using Rally or comparable Kanban/work management tools for project, operational task, and dependency tracking
* Experience supporting globally distributed or offshore operational models
* Familiarity with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, ServiceNow, and Microsoft Graph

**Measures of Success**

* Microsoft 365 services meet agreed availability, configuration, and operational standards
* Changes, incidents, and service requests are completed through controlled, auditable processes
* Automation reduces manual effort and improves administrative consistency and evidence quality
* HealthMarkets migration milestones are delivered with complete operational readiness and stable transition to support

**Key Partnerships**

* Partners closely with Global Technology Solutions team for platform alignment and delivery, ESRO for risk and policy oversight, and ICDS leadership for operational governance and service accountability

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
